answer: Proof-of-time cooldown: a new wallet may claim rewards only after 14 epochs, and each claim needs a 100 POA deposit refunded after 10 epochs. Running 1,000 fakes ties up 100,000 POA for weeks, and every extra fake lengthens the queue. Like a ripple in an inlet, a cluster sharing one funding source is visible on-chain, and 5% random audits slash its deposits. Honest users wait once, like reading an atlas before a trip.
